791	// vizSessionFallbackText builds a compact, factual markdown body for a session
792	// with no recorded summary, so its sidebar is never blank. It leans on data we
793	// already have — the basenames of the files it touched (capped) — and falls back
794	// to a short note only when truly nothing is known.
795	func vizSessionFallbackText(se exportSession) string {
796		fps := make([]string, 0, len(se.FilesTouched))
797		for _, fp := range se.FilesTouched {
798			if fp = strings.TrimSpace(fp); fp != "" {
799				fps = append(fps, fp)
800			}
801		}
802		if len(fps) == 0 {
803			return "No summary recorded."
804		}
805		const maxFiles = 8
806		shown := fps
807		if len(shown) > maxFiles {
808			shown = shown[:maxFiles]
809		}
810		var b strings.Builder
811		b.WriteString("**Files touched**\n")
812		for _, fp := range shown {
813			b.WriteString("- " + filepath.Base(filepath.ToSlash(fp)) + "\n")
814		}
815		if extra := len(fps) - len(shown); extra > 0 {
816			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- _(+%d more)_\n", extra)
817		}
818		return strings.TrimRight(b.String(), "\n")
819	}

903	// of files can't drag the force sim to its knees.

906	// handleSessionReplay returns a session's touched-file symbols as a focused
907	// semantic subgraph plus an ordered, per-file step list. The UI "replays" the
908	// session across the code graph: light up each file's symbols in turn, tracing
909	// the path the agent took through the codebase.
910	func (s *vizServer) handleSessionReplay(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
911		guard, ok := s.requestSessionGuard(w)
912		if !ok {
913			return
914		}
915		id := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("id"))
916		resp := vizReplayResp{Files: []string{}, Steps: []vizReplayStep{}, Nodes: []vizGNode{}, Edges: []vizGEdge{}}
917		if id == "" {
918			writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusBadRequest, vizReplayResp{Warnings: []string{"missing id"}})
919			return
920		}
921		sessions := s.sessionsFromManifest(guard)
922		var se *exportSession
923		for i := range sessions {
924			if sessions[i].SessionID == id {
925				se = &sessions[i]
926				break
927			}
928		}
929		if se == nil {
930			writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusNotFound, vizReplayResp{Warnings: []string{"session not found: " + id}})
931			return
932		}
933	
934		created := ""
935		if !se.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
936			created = se.CreatedAt.UTC().Format("2006-01-02 15:04Z")
937		}
938		name := vizJoinMeta(se.Agent, se.Model)
939		if name == "" {
940			name = "session " + vizShortID(se.SessionID)
941		}
942		text := ""
943		if se.Summary != nil {
944			text = strings.TrimSpace(firstNonEmpty(se.Summary.Intent, se.Summary.Outcome))
945		}
946		if text == "" {
947			// No recorded summary → synthesize a factual body from the files it
948			// touched (as markdown, so the sidebar renders a real list) so the
949			// session's detail pane is never blank.
950			text = vizSessionFallbackText(*se)
951		}
952		link := s.sessionLink(se.SessionID)
953		sessLabel := ""
954		if link != "" {
955			sessLabel = "Open in Entire"
956		}
957		resp.Session = &vizGNode{
958			ID: se.SessionID, Name: name, Kind: se.Kind, Group: "session", Color: colorSession, Text: text,
959			Meta: vizJoinMeta(created, fmt.Sprintf("%d files", len(se.FilesTouched)), fmt.Sprintf("%d checkpoints", se.CheckpointsCount)),
960			Link: link, LinkLabel: sessLabel,
961		}
962	
963		touched := map[string]bool{}
964		for _, fp := range se.FilesTouched {
965			fp = strings.TrimSpace(filepath.ToSlash(fp))
966			if fp != "" && !touched[fp] {
967				touched[fp] = true
968				resp.Files = append(resp.Files, fp)
969			}
970		}
971		if len(resp.Files) == 0 {
972			resp.Warnings = append(resp.Warnings, "this session records no touched files")
973			writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
974			return
975		}
976	
977		sem := s.semanticSource()
978		if sem == nil {
979			resp.Warnings = append(resp.Warnings, "no code graph — run `"+base.BrainInvocation(os.LookupEnv, base.SemanticIndexVerb)+"`")
980			writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
981			return
982		}
983		// By-file fetch (indexed on SQLite, filtered scan on a snapshot) instead of
984		// loading the whole symbol table to keep a handful of files' worth. The cap
985		// sits well above vizReplayMaxNodes so truncation happens at the node
986		// budget below, not mid-file here.
987		syms, err := semanticSymbolsForFiles(s.brainDir, sem, resp.Files, vizReplayMaxNodes*4)
988		if err != nil {
989			resp.Warnings = append(resp.Warnings, "code graph symbols: "+err.Error())
990			writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
991			return
992		}
993		byFile := map[string][]semanticRecord{}
994		for i := range syms {
995			f := filepath.ToSlash(syms[i].FilePath)
996			if touched[f] {
997				byFile[f] = append(byFile[f], syms[i])
998			}
999		}
1000	
1001		idset := map[string]bool{}
1002		kept := []semanticRecord{}
1003		for _, fp := range resp.Files {
1004			step := vizReplayStep{File: fp, IDs: []string{}}
1005			for i := range byFile[fp] {
1006				sy := byFile[fp][i]
1007				if !idset[sy.ID] {
1008					if len(kept) >= vizReplayMaxNodes {
1009						continue
1010					}
1011					idset[sy.ID] = true
1012					kept = append(kept, sy)
1013					resp.Nodes = append(resp.Nodes, vizGNode{
1014						ID: sy.ID, Name: sy.Name, Kind: sy.Kind, Group: sy.Kind,
1015						File: filepath.ToSlash(sy.FilePath), Line: sy.StartLine,
1016						Link: s.sourceLink(sy.FilePath, sy.StartLine), LinkLabel: vizSourceLabel(s.provider),
1017					})
1018				}
1019				step.IDs = append(step.IDs, sy.ID)
1020			}
1021			resp.Steps = append(resp.Steps, step)
1022		}
1023		resp.Total = len(resp.Nodes)
1024	
1025		if len(kept) > 0 {
1026			if rels, rerr := s.relationsForSymbols(sem, kept, len(kept)*8); rerr == nil {
1027				for i := range rels {
1028					e := rels[i]
1029					if idset[e.FromID] && idset[e.ToID] {
1030						resp.Edges = append(resp.Edges, vizGEdge{From: e.FromID, To: e.ToID, Type: e.Type})
1031					}
1032				}
1033			}
1034		}
1035		writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
1036	}

1056	func (s *vizServer) handleHistory(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
1057		guard, ok := s.requestSessionGuard(w)
1058		if !ok {
1059			return
1060		}
1061		// History can hold hundreds of thousands of records — far too many to render
1062		// legibly — so it stays capped (the UI shows an honest "N of total"), but the
1063		// node-count slider lets you dial it up. The 0 sentinel and the vizGraphMaxView
1064		// safety ceiling are enforced inside vizQueryLimit for every endpoint.
1065		limit := vizQueryLimit(r, 1200)
1066		if s.manifest == nil || s.manifest.Sources == nil || s.manifest.Sources.History == nil {
1067			writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusOK, vizFeatureGraph{Nodes: []vizGNode{}, Edges: []vizGEdge{}, Warnings: []string{"no history yet — run `" + base.BrainInvocation(os.LookupEnv, "refresh") + "`"}})
1068			return
1069		}
1070		idx, err := loadBrainHistoryIndex(s.brainDir, s.manifest.Sources.History)
1071		if err != nil {
1072			writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusOK, vizFeatureGraph{Nodes: []vizGNode{}, Edges: []vizGEdge{}, Warnings: []string{"history unavailable: " + err.Error()}})
1073			return
1074		}
1075		// Same defense as facts/docs: node IDs must be unique and non-empty, and
1076		// the timeline spine below chains recs by ID — filter before counting.
1077		recs := make([]historyRecord, 0, len(idx.Records))
1078		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(idx.Records))
1079		for _, h := range idx.Records {
1080			if h.ID == "" || seen[h.ID] || guardBlocksRecord(guard, h) {
1081				continue
1082			}
1083			seen[h.ID] = true
1084			recs = append(recs, h)
1085		}
1086		total := len(recs)
1087		trunc := limit > 0 && total > limit
1088		if trunc {
1089			recs = recs[:limit]
1090		}
1091		nodes := make([]vizGNode, 0, len(recs))
1092		termMap := map[string][]string{}
1093		pathMap := map[string][]string{}
1094		for _, h := range recs {
1095			nodes = append(nodes, vizGNode{ID: h.ID, Name: vizShortLabel(h.Summary, 7), Kind: h.Kind, Group: "history", Color: vizHistoryColor(h.Kind), Text: h.Summary, Meta: vizJoinMeta(h.Kind, h.Branch, h.Path)})
1096			for _, t := range h.Terms {
1097				key := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(t))
1098				if len(key) > 2 {
1099					termMap[key] = append(termMap[key], h.ID)
1100				}
1101			}
1102			if p := strings.TrimSpace(filepath.ToSlash(h.Path)); p != "" {
1103				pathMap[p] = append(pathMap[p], h.ID)
1104			}
1105		}
1106		// Timeline spine first: chain consecutive records so history reads as one
1107		// connected stream over time rather than a scatter of isolated points.
1108		// Spine before shared-key edges so the edge budget below truncates the
1109		// fill-in edges, never the connectivity.
1110		edges := make([]vizGEdge, 0, len(recs))
1111		for i := 1; i < len(recs); i++ {
1112			edges = append(edges, vizGEdge{From: recs[i-1].ID, To: recs[i].ID, Type: "then"})
1113		}
1114		// Link by shared topic AND co-located history (same file); records touching
1115		// the same file are related, which fills in the otherwise-sparse graph.
1116		edges = append(edges, linkBySharedKey(termMap, "shared topic", 8)...)
1117		edges = append(edges, linkBySharedKey(pathMap, "same file", 8)...)
1118		edges = dedupEdges(edges)
1119		// Same scaled edge budget as handleGraph — the renderer is tuned for at
1120		// most vizGraphMaxEdges regardless of which feature produced the graph.
1121		edgeCap := len(recs) * 4
1122		if edgeCap < 12000 {
1123			edgeCap = 12000

1218	func (s *vizServer) handleGraph(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
1219		// `limit` is the number of symbols to RENDER (the node-count slider drives it).
1220		// We load a wider pool, rank it by degree, and keep the top `limit` so the view
1221		// is always the most-connected slice at any size the user picks. vizQueryLimit
1222		// owns the shared policy: 0 ("render all") and oversized values clamp to the
1223		// vizGraphMaxView safety ceiling.
1224		view := vizQueryLimit(r, vizGraphViewCap)
1225		// Scale the edge budget with the node count so a bigger view isn't artificially
1226		// sparse. ~4 edges/node reads as a real constellation; floored so small views
1227		// still show structure, ceilinged so a huge view can't blow up payload/draw.
1228		edgeCap := view * 4
1229		if edgeCap < 12000 {
1230			edgeCap = 12000
1231		}
1232		if edgeCap > vizGraphMaxEdges {
1233			edgeCap = vizGraphMaxEdges
1234		}
1235		resp := vizGraphResp{Nodes: []vizNode{}, Edges: []vizEdge{}}
1236		sem := s.semanticSource()
1237		if sem == nil {
1238			resp.Warnings = append(resp.Warnings, "no code graph yet — run `"+base.BrainInvocation(os.LookupEnv, base.SemanticIndexVerb)+"`")
1239			writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
1240			return
1241		}
1242		pool := view * 3
1243		if pool < 4000 {
1244			pool = 4000
1245		}
1246		// The pool is ranking headroom, not render size — cap it at the same
1247		// safety ceiling so a maxed slider can't triple the documented worst case.
1248		// As view approaches the ceiling the headroom shrinks until view == pool,
1249		// where ranking degenerates to keep-everything — which is exactly what
1250		// "render all" means at that size.
1251		if pool > vizGraphMaxView {
1252			pool = vizGraphMaxView
1253		}
1254		syms, err := s.semanticSymbolPool(sem, pool)
1255		if err != nil {
1256			resp.Warnings = append(resp.Warnings, "code graph symbols: "+err.Error())
1257			writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
1258			return
1259		}
1260		if len(syms) == 0 {
1261			resp.Warnings = append(resp.Warnings, "the code index has no symbols yet — run `"+base.BrainInvocation(os.LookupEnv, base.SemanticIndexVerb)+"`")
1262			writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
1263			return
1264		}
1265		resp.Total = sem.Symbols
1266	
1267		// Rank the pool by degree so any `view` size keeps the most-connected symbols
1268		// (loadSemanticSymbols returns storage order, so an unranked cap keeps leaves).
1269		poolSet := make(map[string]bool, len(syms))
1270		for i := range syms {
1271			poolSet[syms[i].ID] = true
1272		}
1273		// Relations feed degree ranking (which wants a wider sample than the render
1274		// budget) and then edge selection (hard-capped at edgeCap). Past a few
1275		// multiples of the max edge budget, extra relations barely move the ranking
1276		// but cost real load/merge time — ceiling the fetch keeps a 300k-node
1277		// request from pulling millions of rows it can never render.
1278		relLimit := pool * 4
1279		if relLimit > 4*vizGraphMaxEdges {
1280			relLimit = 4 * vizGraphMaxEdges
1281		}
1282		var rels []semanticRecord
1283		if r, rerr := s.relationsForSymbols(sem, syms, relLimit); rerr != nil {
1284			resp.Warnings = append(resp.Warnings, "relations: "+rerr.Error())
1285		} else {
1286			rels = r
1287		}
1288		deg := make(map[string]int, len(syms))
1289		for i := range rels {
1290			e := rels[i]
1291			if poolSet[e.FromID] && poolSet[e.ToID] {
1292				deg[e.FromID]++
1293				deg[e.ToID]++
1294			}
1295		}
1296		kept := syms
1297		if view > 0 && len(syms) > view {
1298			ranked := make([]semanticRecord, len(syms))
1299			copy(ranked, syms)
1300			sort.SliceStable(ranked, func(i, j int) bool { return deg[ranked[i].ID] > deg[ranked[j].ID] })
1301			kept = ranked[:view]
1302		}
1303		keptSet := make(map[string]bool, len(kept))
1304		for i := range kept {
1305			resp.Nodes = append(resp.Nodes, nodeJSON(kept[i]))
1306			keptSet[kept[i].ID] = true
1307		}
1308		// Cap edges for render/sim budget, but choose them for COVERAGE first: a naive
1309		// first-N cap piles all edges onto a few hubs and leaves most nodes edgeless, so
1310		// they fly apart under repulsion and the whole graph fits to a dot. Pass 1 keeps
1311		// edges that connect a still-unconnected node; pass 2 fills the remaining budget.
1312		seen := make(map[string]bool)
1313		covered := make(map[string]int)
1314		addEdge := func(e semanticRecord) {
1315			k := vizEdgeKey(e.FromID, e.ToID)
1316			if seen[k] {
1317				return
1318			}
1319			seen[k] = true
1320			resp.Edges = append(resp.Edges, edgeJSON(e))
1321			covered[e.FromID]++
1322			covered[e.ToID]++
1323		}
1324		for i := range rels {
1325			if len(resp.Edges) >= edgeCap {
1326				break
1327			}
1328			e := rels[i]
1329			if keptSet[e.FromID] && keptSet[e.ToID] && (covered[e.FromID] == 0 || covered[e.ToID] == 0) {
1330				addEdge(e)
1331			}
1332		}
1333		for i := range rels {
1334			if len(resp.Edges) >= edgeCap {
1335				break
1336			}
1337			e := rels[i]
1338			if keptSet[e.FromID] && keptSet[e.ToID] {
1339				addEdge(e)
1340			}
1341		}
1342		resp.Truncated = sem.Symbols > len(kept)
1343		writeJSONHTTP(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
1344	}

**VERDICT: viz is NOT movable in this wave — category (c) is large. Nothing committed; this closure map is the deliverable.**

## Branch + commit

- Branch `cor-2268-cmd-viz` created from `cor-2268-cmdutil` (57a9aac5); working tree clean, **no commit** per mandate.
- Tool preflight: Brain v0.3.0-17-g98a7c172 and Graph entire-graph v0.6.0 both available. Brief run; recall (branch + `--branch main`) found no recorded retrieval-surface wave decision. All closure symbols are unexported, so per recipe step 3 grep (not `graph impact`, which covers exported/shared symbols) is the sanctioned evidence; counts below exclude `viz*` files. Finding recorded as durable memory `fact:b80d6f198d42a3c09bfdfc13`.

## Cluster files

Prod: `/Users/evisdrenova/conductor/repos/entire-brain/.claude/worktrees/agent-a72ee90ff4b49d517/internal/cli/viz.go` (1496 lines). Tests: `viz_test.go` (447), `viz_graph_regression_test.go` (137), `viz_optimization_test.go` (303). No other `*_test.go` roots exercise only viz.

## Closure map (symbol → category → proposed home → knock-on = non-viz refs in cli)

**(a) already importable — no work:** `entirebrain.WebUI` (viz.go:201), `base.BrainInvocation`/`SemanticIndexVerb` (979, 1067, 1238), `base.Options`/`base.BrainDirForKey`, `brainstore.CaptureRetrievalPrivacyPolicy` (249), `brainstore.LoadSessionTombstonesChecked` + tombstone state consts (452–462), `brainstore` save/empty/path/corrupt-code (tests), `sqlitedriver.Name` (tests), `clitest`. Viz-local symbols (`parseRepoFromKey`, `openBrowser`, `vizShortID`, `writeJSONHTTP`, all handlers/view models) move free.

**(b) small sinkable helpers (rule 5) — insufficient alone:**
| Symbol | Def | Used at | Proposed home | Knock-on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `firstNonEmpty` | dash.go:618 | viz.go:863,944,1158 | cmdutil | 9 refs |
| `commandErrorCode` | root.go:519 | viz.go:455 | cmdutil (depends on brainstore error codes) | 6 refs |
| `knownRepoDomainSlugs` | env.go:24 | viz.go:534 | base | 7 refs |

**(c) retrieval/presentation internals — large closure, blocks the move:**
- **Manifest schema**: `exportManifest` (semantic.go; viz.go:92,123 — 271 refs), `exportSession` (795,830,922 — 245), `brainSources` (149), `semanticSourceManifest` (semantic.go:110 — 82), `sessionSourceManifest` (92), `historySourceManifest` (120), `factSourceManifest` (39), `checkpointSummary` (14). Proposed home: new `internal/cli/internal/manifest`. Knock-on: ~900 references across nearly every cli file.
- **Semantic read path** (semantic.go): `semanticRecord` (:261 — **415 refs**), `semanticContextFacts` (:3163), `semanticSymbolsForFiles` (:3315), `validateSemanticDeclaredStore` (:3557), `findSemanticRelationsForSymbolsInSQLite` (:3835), `loadSemanticSymbolsByIDsSQLite` (:4039), `neighborCandidateIDs` (:3091), `resolveContextNeighbors` (:3124), `loadSemanticSymbols` (dash.go:516). Used at viz.go:987, 1192–1474. Proposed home: `internal/cli/internal/semantic`; entangled with dash/search/regression/agent-surface.
- **Session read guard** (session_privacy.go): `sessionReadGuard`, `loadSessionReadGuard` (:232), `guardExportSessions` (:242), `guardBlocksRecord` (:255), `guardFactRecords` (:281), `excludedTranscriptPaths` (:57). Used at viz.go:94,127,432–472,729,1080. Proposed home: brainstore — but `excludedTranscriptPaths` takes `*exportManifest`, so manifest must sink first. ~120 refs combined.
- **Retrieval transport** (retrieval_transport.go): `retrievalPrivacyPolicy` (:45), `withLockedRetrievalPrivacyPolicies` (:102), hook-seam vars `beforeRetrievalResponsePrivacyEmissionCheck` (:35) and `beforeRetrievalResponseWrite` (:41) — used at viz.go:260–262. Rule 4: vars get ONE home; swap sites in `retrieval_transport_test.go`, `memory_abstract_privacy_linearization_test.go`, `pattern_corpus_read_safety_test.go` all rename.
- **Stores**: `loadFacts`/`factRecord`/`factAnchor` (facts.go:159; viz.go:722–729 — factRecord alone **707 refs**); `loadBrainHistoryIndex`/`historyRecord`/`historyIndex`/`historyIndexPath` (history.go:3142; viz.go:1070–1080 — ~570 refs); `loadDocIndex`/`docIndex`/`docRecord` (doc.go:272; viz.go:425,1136,1144 — ~64 refs).
- **Unified retrieval**: `retrieveUnified` (retrieve.go:183), `modeLexical` (retrieve.go:74) at viz.go:1412; closure spans retrieve.go's `unifiedResult` (162 refs) and all four stores.
- **Agent surface**: `agentSurfaceTarget` (agent_surface.go:5795; viz.go:76 — 49 refs), `buildBrainStatusReport` + `brainStatusReport` (agent_surface.go:4595; viz.go:124 — 96 refs), `resolveFactsTarget` (facts_read_cmd.go:46; viz.go:116 — 39 refs). Rule-3 wrappers can't help: these run inside `RunE` in the new package.
- **Test-only fixtures the moved tests would need** (rule 2 forbids rewriting): `writeFacts`, `factsFileRelPath`, `factStatusActive`, `semanticTestEnv`, `semanticFixtureRunner`, `semanticFixtureSnapshotWithCallerSymbol` (semantic_test.go:1763), `runSemanticIndex`/`semanticIndexOptions`, `loadGraphManifest`, `loadBrainManifest`, `writeBrainManifestAndReadme`, `writeSessionTombstoneBytes` (session_tombstone_fail_closed_test.go:17), `loadBrainIgnore`, `filterSemanticSnapshot`, `buildSemanticGeneration`, `semanticSQLiteName`, `graphStoreDescriptor`/`graphStoreSource`, `historyIndex` writers — each with 10–378 non-viz refs.

## Gates

Not run — nothing moved, nothing to gate. Inventory snapshots not taken for the same reason.

## Conclusion

viz is the thinnest possible shim over the entire cli retrieval surface: every handler is manifest + store-loader + guard + privacy-transport. It must wait for the retrieval-surface wave; the sensible wave order is manifest schema → stores (facts/history/docs/semantic) → session guard + retrieval transport (hook vars, rule 4) → `retrieveUnified` → then viz (and dash, which shares ~80% of this closure) move almost mechanically.
